notes.title: 🚽 Welcome to Toilet Clicker!
notes.content:
Hey everyone — and welcome to the first-ever Toilet Clicker update post!Whether you found this game on Steam, Kickstarter, or just stumbled in by accident… I’m really glad you’re here. 


What is Toilet Clicker?Toilet Clicker is a chaotic, fast-paced indie clicker game, full of various minigames, where you press a toilet, buy upgrades, collect flushes and gather hundreds of weird, cursed, and hilarious items. Every click is a surprise — sometimes it’s trash, sometimes it’s treasure (and sometimes it’s… questionable).I started this project as a solo dev with a simple goal:
Make something fun, weird, and endlessly satisfying to play.
[strike]And it’s growing fast.


[/strike]What's Already In?
✅ over 50 Upgrades — boost your flushes and drop rates.
✅ 4 Minigames — short, silly and quite challenging events before item drops, 
✅ Idle income — earn even when your game is turned off,
✅ Quality-of-life improvements all around,
✅ 50 Unique, and RIDICULOUS items, of various rarities, and more on the way!
✅ Evolution system, which makes the game worth re-playing,
✅ Item Album — keep track of your items, and feel the progression!


More features are on the way!


🫧 Be Part of the Community
Want to suggest your own item ideas? Report bugs? Hang out with other flushers?

We’ve got a Discord server where all of that’s happening:
